disposition_reason: Edible parts of ten vegetables bought at Novi Sad green markets (six localities each) were analysed for cadmium, lead, chromium, nickel and four macroelements; Tables 1-4 print every locality mean.

study.design: green-market survey of ten vegetable species from six localities
study.origin: different localities in the vicinity of Novi Sad, Serbia (small farms)
study.market: three green markets, Novi Sad, Serbia
study.method: oven-dried 80 °C, closed-vessel microwave digestion, flame AAS (Varian AAS240FS)
study.qa: triplicate analyses; no CRM or recovery reported
